<translate>
'''Yamcha's House''' is [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha|Yamcha]]'s hideout in the deserts of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Yamcha trains anyone regardless of alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here ==
</translate>
<translate>
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha|Yamcha]]''' teaches [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]], the Spirit Ball, the Kamehameha, Ki Barrage and his Wolf Fang strike. He has no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
Yamcha's House generates once per world, in a desert. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Yamcha's House Map''' at trade tier 2, for 1 Bone and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate yamcha_house}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
Like every master's home, the house can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>
